name: USA 1944 (Marianas)
description:
US forces in the Marianas, June to August 1944: Operation Forager.

The P-47D is not a substitute here. The 318th Fighter Group flew Thunderbolts off Aslito Field from 22 June 1944, a week after the Saipan landings, and Aslito is Isley on this map. Marine and Navy Corsairs and the Essex-class carriers of Task Force 58 round it out.

No Hellcat, Avenger, Dauntless or B-24 in DCS, so the B-17G stands in for the heavy bombers and the A-20G for the mediums. Landing craft and the LST are the real thing.
